newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Auspine receives board change request.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Auspine receives board change request.

text.p: Timber producer Auspine Ltd said on Tuesday that it had received a requisition for a general meeting of shareholders to be held to consider a resolution to replace director Rodney Hartley.
In a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX), Auspine said the resolution proposed that Geoffrey Hill be appointed to replace Hartley.
"The company is seeking legal advice as to the validity of the requisition and will further advise the ASX in due course," Auspine said in the statement.
On Monday the company said it had referred complaints about share trading by managing director Adrian de Bruin and director Keith Veall to the Australian Securities Commission (ASC).

Auspine former director Ron Bassett said he resigned after finding his position untenable following what he called significant delays in de Bruin and Veall submitting satisfactory responses to a board sub-committee dealing with the share trading issue.
The company was suspended at the director's request on Friday, pending an announcement, and was reinstated on Monday.
Auspine shares closed six cents higher at A$3.16 after falling 21 cents to A$3.10 on Monday following the reinstatement.
